name: Cervantes / Elena · steps beside the ramp
trust: Three shallow steps on the north half of the lane, beside the smooth ramp, starting about one tile up from the foot drain (IMG_2286, IMG_2262). White-painted risers, terracotta treads with grey stone edges. Tread lengths from the 0.4 m tiles; together they climb the same 0.5 m as the ramp, which reaches the top tread's level 3.0 m up. Positions approximate (about 0.2 m).
